summary: MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor thunk: runs the destructor via ExceptionDestructorSEHWrapper(a2), then frees the object storage through FreeWrapper_7bcf only when the deletion flag a3 has bit 0 set, and returns the object pointer a1.

operations.description: Invoke ExceptionDestructorSEHWrapper(a2), the destructor-body call taking the ebp-relative parameter a2.
Test whether the scalar-deleting-destructor deletion flag a3 has its low bit set.
When the flag bit is set, free the object memory via FreeWrapper_7bcf(a1).
Return a1, the object pointer, matching the scalar-deleting-destructor convention of returning this.

unresolved: The concrete object class is unknown; a2 is an exception-frame/ebp-relative argument whose exact type is not identified.
Whether ExceptionDestructorSEHWrapper is the destructor body or an SEH-guarded cleanup wrapper is not confirmed.
